howItWorks.title: How Kabadiwala Connect Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Bridging local informal collection with industrial recycling giants through artificial intelligence and real-time market matching.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Take a photo of your scrap lot (PCBs, copper wire, motors, batteries). Drag & drop directly into our app.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our vision model recognizes material purity, category, and fetches live state-level price recommendations.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Smart matchmaking ranks nearby verified recyclers offering the highest bids and scheduled doorstep pickups.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Handover with GPS verification and calibrated scale check. Payout is transferred instantly to your account.

features.title: Built for Transparency & Social Impact
features.subtitle: Engineered from the ground up to empower millions of micro-entrepreneurs in India's circular economy.
features.aiDesc: Trained specifically on Indian e-waste streams to distinguish between copper winding, aluminum alloys, cathode ray glass, and printed circuit boards.
